architecture_principles: the unit of decision is an experiment, not a formulation
value of information is computed by a deterministic scientific tool, not by an additional language model
every registered hypothesis carries an explicit pre-result prediction rule and an explicit falsification condition
a measurement that cannot separate any registered hypothesis scores zero discrimination, and that is a scientific result rather than a defect
weight sensitivity is reported as decision stability, never as model confidence
ties in the deterministic layer are reported as ties; the tool must not manufacture a preference it does not have
held-out result data are structurally removed before any payload is assembled
the mechanism question and the Agent framework are separate contributions and are reported separately

candidate_space.rationale: V4 deliberately reuses the byte-identical V3 lattice. Continuous-space optimization and any new wet-lab work are out of scope, so that the measured change between V3 and V4 is the decision object and the VOI layer, not the search space.

architecture.canonical_flow: planner(intent + failure mode) -> evidence/tool layer (including the deterministic VOI tool) -> proposer -> skeptic -> robustness adjudicator -> judge -> freeze
architecture.claim_boundary: V4.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime. Its adjudication tests whether a registered hypothesis survives contact with the completed measurement. It is not a contemporaneous pre-experimental record and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.
architecture.name: PUR_NEW_VOI_GUIDED_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION_AGENT_V4
non_goals: adding a language model to compute value of information
adding Agent roles beyond planner, tools, proposer, skeptic, robustness adjudicator, judge and freeze
turning the study into a pure AI benchmark
weakening or replacing the rheological mechanism result
architecture.purpose: Outcome-blind scientific decision Agent that selects the next formulation x measurement EXPERIMENT by transparent value of information, rather than selecting a formulation candidate alone.

stages.role: identify the physical failure mode and the scientific question that the next experiment must answer, then request the evidence needed to judge experiments rather than formulations

execute read-only scientific tools, including the paper-derived state-aware rheology tool, external evidence retrieval, and the deterministic VOI tool that scores every formulation x measurement experiment card
propose the experiment with the highest scientific information value, stating the hypotheses it separates and what each possible outcome would establish
attack the proposed experiment on hypothesis coverage, confounding, interpretability of the primary observable, and whether the stated falsification criterion can actually be met by the measurement
adjudicate whether the proposed experiment survives the reported VOI weight sensitivity and the skeptic's strongest objection
commit to one experiment card, or abstain, and state the acceptance and falsification criteria that will adjudicate it
programmatically validate and freeze the experiment card with timestamps, model identifiers and cryptographic hashes of every input

architecture.supersedes_nothing: V4 is an independent architecture. configs/agent_v3.json, prompts/agent_v3_*.txt, src/pur_new/agent_v3.py and every frozen V3 run record remain unchanged and are not reinterpreted by V4.

voi_tool.explicitly_not: distance to any held-out formulation. No target coordinate enters any component, weight or tie-break.
voi_tool.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk
voi_tool.name: score_experiment_cards
voi_tool.not_a_posterior: The local design contains six audited realizations and two thermal-hold trajectories. That does not support a calibrated Bayesian expected-information computation, so no posterior probability is fabricated. Weight sensitivity is reported instead.

evidence_policy.description: For prospective/blind Agent evaluation. The Agent may see original-system measurements and external analogue evidence, but not the target validation formulation identity, its wet-lab outcome, or any outcome-derived labels.

judge_normalized.acceptance_criterion: Across at least two independent preparations, the mean SI_15_60 is between 7.51% and 11.51% inclusive, corresponding to agreement within the declared 2.00 percentage-point resolution of the H-CORE linear-dilution prediction of 9.51%.
judge_normalized.falsification_criterion: H-CORE is falsified if the mean SI_15_60 is below 7.51% or above 11.51%, because the result then differs from 9.51% by more than the declared 2.00 percentage-point resolution. In particular, a mean below 4.75% is a strong low-drift departure from H-CORE. This card cannot falsify H-RESIN or H-DUAL because neither modifier axis is present.
judge_normalized.next_experiment_if_falsified: Run a controlled matched-reactive-mass-fraction M-HOLD-120 comparison including the unmodified E2 core, an acrylic-only composition, a composition with non-zero minor tackifier-like modifier, and preferably the combined-modifier composition, with at least two independent preparations per composition and a common recorded preparation history.
judge_normalized.primary_observable: SI_15_60 = (eta_60 - eta_15) / eta_15, percent, measured at 120 C over 15-60 minutes
judge_normalized.rationale: S1C02::M-HOLD-120 is a defensible baseline probe for whether the E2-centre reactive core agrees with the frozen 9.51% linear-dilution reference under the directly observed 120 C hold. It is not a modifier-mechanism test, so interpretation is restricted to H-CORE compatibility and baseline drift.
judge_normalized.stage_disagreements_resolved: I followed the robustness adjudicator and proposer in selecting the E2-centre S1C02 anchor because it minimizes unsupported stoichiometric departure while directly measuring the unresolved hold-drift coordinate. I followed the skeptic in removing the proposer's invalid claims that this control can falsify H-RESIN or H-DUAL; those hypotheses remain entangled and untested here.

uncertainty_decomposition.evidence_coverage_uncertainty: High for H-RESIN and H-DUAL because S1C02 contains no acrylic-like or minor tackifier-like modifier; the experiment provides only a reactive-core baseline.
uncertainty_decomposition.extrapolation_uncertainty: Low for the 15-60 minute, 120 C drift coordinate because the observable is measured directly in the established window; high for any inference about modifier behavior or molecular causes.
uncertainty_decomposition.measurement_uncertainty: The matched-window observable is directly read from viscosity at 15, 30, 45 and 60 minutes, with a declared discrimination resolution of 2.00 percentage points; two repeats provide limited precision.
uncertainty_decomposition.realization_state_uncertainty: Moderate to high: M-HOLD-120 does not control preparation history, and the supplied evidence shows substantial realization-dependent viscosity-scale spread. Drift may also vary with preparation state.

planner.failure_mode: Viscosity growth during prolonged 120 C melt residence, with the magnitude and mechanism of thermal-hold drift unresolved
planner.failure_mode_evidence: At 120 C, the original E5 formulation increased by 51.54% from 15 to 60 minutes, compared with 9.51% for E1 over the same measured window.
planner.least_resolved_justification: The isothermal coordinate is represented by only four time points from 15 to 60 minutes and only one original run each for E1 and E5. The available data therefore establish a large endpoint contrast but do not resolve the trajectory shape or repeatability. In contrast, temperature response has six measured temperatures with multiple E2 realizations, although its viscosity-scale spread is large.
measurement_requirements: Measure viscosity at 120 C at 15, 30, 45, and 60 minutes and report the matched-window SI_15_60 relative change.
Use at least two independent preparation repeats so drift differences can be compared against measurement and preparation variability.
Include compositionally matched comparisons that distinguish an acrylic-only modifier axis from a composition with a non-zero minor tackifier-like axis.
Record the reactive mass fraction and compare observed drift with the frozen linear-dilution prediction, without extrapolating beyond the 15-60 minute measured window.
Retain the realized viscosity level and temperature support measurements so drift suppression is not confounded with an uncharacterized state shift.
planner.scientific_question: At matched reactive mass fraction and within the measured 120 C time window, does modifier addition suppress viscosity-growth drift beyond the linear reactive-core dilution prediction, and is low drift achieved only when the minor tackifier-like axis is present rather than with the acrylic-like axis alone?

hypotheses_not_separated: H-CORE: the reactive-core prediction is indistinguishable from the other registered predictions for this composition.
H-RESIN: no resin-modified composition is tested, so the experiment cannot directly establish resin-specific superlinear suppression.
H-DUAL: no acrylic-like or minor tackifier-like axis is active, so the experiment cannot test whether tackifier presence is required for low drift.

outcome_interpretation.if_acceptance_criterion_met: If drift is below 4.75% across at least two repeats, the result is inconsistent with the frozen linear-dilution reference and falsifies H-CORE at the declared resolution; it supports the possibility of non-dilution suppression, although this reactive-core-only experiment cannot attribute that suppression to either modifier axis.
outcome_interpretation.if_falsification_criterion_met: If drift is at or above 9.51%, the result falsifies the card's H-RESIN low-drift criterion and provides no evidence for suppression beyond the reactive-core reference. H-CORE remains compatible with a result near the linear-dilution prediction.
outcome_interpretation.if_intermediate: A result between 4.75% and 9.51%, or repeat-to-repeat variation spanning these thresholds, is ambiguous: it does not cleanly distinguish the registered mechanisms within the 2.00% resolution rule and should not be interpreted as evidence for either modifier-axis specialization.

ranked_alternatives.why_lower_value: It is deterministically tied, but its formulation is a stoichiometric departure from the E2 centre and is therefore less representative of the characterized local anchor.
It is deterministically tied, but it introduces a larger stoichiometric departure from the E2-centred reactive core without increasing hypothesis discrimination.
It is deterministically tied, but it changes the reactive-core composition axis rather than directly testing the modifier hypotheses and is less central to the audited local design.

proposer.reasoning: The direct 120 C matched-window hold is the most interpretable measurement for the unresolved isothermal drift coordinate, but this tied reactive-core set does not actually separate any registered hypothesis pair because all three predictions coincide at this composition. S1C02 is selected only because it is the E2 geometric-centre anchor, minimizing unsupported local extrapolation and preserving comparability with the state-aware rheology evidence.
proposer.tie_break_justification: S1C02 uses the E2 reactive-core anchor, identified as the geometric centre of the characterized local design. It therefore minimizes unsupported stoichiometric or composition departure while retaining the direct 120 C matched-window hold measurement. This is a scientific representativeness choice within a genuine deterministic tie, not a ranking by card order.

residual_decision_risk: The experiment leaves H-CORE, H-RESIN, and H-DUAL entangled at the tested composition.
The process-state risk remains moderate because M-HOLD-120 does not control preparation history and only two repeats are required.
A low drift result cannot be attributed to either modifier axis.
A high drift result cannot falsify H-RESIN because no resin-modified composition is tested.
The withheld stability ablation prevents identification of perturbation-specific decision flips.
robustness_adjudication.skeptic_objection_reasoning: The strongest objection is correct that S1C02 contains no acrylic-like or minor-tackifier-like modifier and therefore cannot discriminate H-RESIN from H-CORE or test H-DUAL. However, the proposer explicitly declares those hypotheses unseparated and frames S1C02 as a reactive-core baseline for the unresolved 120 C isothermal drift coordinate. Thus the objection does not invalidate running this baseline experiment; it restricts the result to baseline drift and H-CORE-compatible interpretation. It also invalidates any claim that a high-drift result falsifies H-RESIN. A modifier-axis comparison should be run in a subsequent or expanded experiment if the objective is mechanism discrimination.
robustness_adjudication.weight_sensitivity_assessment: S1C02::M-HOLD-120 is inside the deterministic tied top set with S1C01::M-HOLD-120 through S1C09::M-HOLD-120. The supplied report withholds decision-stability results, including top_experiment_set_stability, base_margin_to_first_strictly_lower, and recommendation_flip_boundary; therefore no specific weight perturbation or its scientific defensibility can be identified. Within the reported deterministic tie, choosing S1C02 is scientifically defensible because it is the E2 geometric-centre anchor and minimizes unsupported stoichiometric departure.

skeptic.falsification_criterion_assessment: The numerical H-CORE criterion is attainable: the protocol directly measures SI_15_60, and the 4.75% cutoff is 4.76 percentage points below the 9.51% prediction, exceeding the declared 2.00% resolution. However, the protocol cannot validly meet the stated H-RESIN falsification claim because no resin-modified composition is tested. Two repeats also provide only limited protection against the stated uncontrolled process-state risk.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A result from S1C02 cannot support or reject the claimed modifier-axis mechanisms. Any conclusion about H-RESIN or H-DUAL would be unsupported.
objections.objection: The selected S1C02 formulation has AC1920 = 0.0%, TK100 = 0.0%, and reactive_mass_fraction = 1.0000. Consequently, the hypothesis_discrimination_detail gives identical predictions of 9.51% for H-CORE, H-RESIN, and H-DUAL, with score 0.0 and no separated pairs. The 120 C hold therefore measures only the reactive-core baseline; it cannot test resin-specific suppression, acrylic-only behavior, or tackifier requirement.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The experiment could incorrectly claim falsification of H-RESIN from a control measurement that contains no acrylic-like or minor-tackifier-like modifier.
objections.objection: The outcome_interpretation states that drift at or above 9.51% 'falsifies' H-RESIN, but H-RESIN is a hypothesis about a resin-modified composition and S1C02 contains no resin. At this composition all registered predictions coincide, so a high drift result cannot falsify resin-modification behavior in a composition that was never tested.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: An unusually low or high 15-60 minute drift could reflect preparation or realization state rather than reactive-core behavior, weakening even the proposed baseline falsification of H-CORE.
objections.objection: There is no composition-axis confounding in S1C02 because neither modifier axis is changed. However, the M-HOLD-120 protocol does not control process state, and the card reports process_state_risk = 0.75 with six missing process fields. The protocol specifies only 'at least two independent repeats' and does not specify the controlled preparation history used for comparison.

skeptic.recommended_change: Replace the reactive-core-only S1C02 hold with a controlled matched-reactive-mass-fraction comparison containing at least the unmodified core control, an acrylic-only composition, and a composition with a non-zero minor tackifier-like fraction; ideally include the combined-modifier composition. Run the same 120 C, 15-30-45-60 minute hold with at least two independent preparations per composition and specify a common preparation history and acceptance rule. This is required to test H-RESIN and H-DUAL rather than merely establish a baseline.
skeptic.strongest_objection: The selected S1C02 formulation has AC1920 = 0.0%, TK100 = 0.0%, and reactive_mass_fraction = 1.0000. Consequently, the hypothesis_discrimination_detail gives identical predictions of 9.51% for H-CORE, H-RESIN, and H-DUAL, with score 0.0 and no separated pairs. The 120 C hold therefore measures only the reactive-core baseline; it cannot test resin-specific suppression, acrylic-only behavior, or tackifier requirement.

tool_trace.name: get_state_aware_rheology_summary
tool_trace.reason: Required first to load the upstream material-structure and state-shift evidence before candidate or experiment ranking is admissible.

claim_boundaries: The shared-shape/state-shift structure is established only within the measured local chemistry family.
The apparent E_eta descriptor is rheological, not a chemical reaction activation energy.
The E1/E5 hold contrast does not identify a unique molecular mechanism.
The phosphoric-acid-labelled E1 +P curve is not used in the chemistry-audited primary state model.
No validation-formulation identity or outcome is used by this tool.
design_rules: Represent a candidate as formulation plus process/realization state, not composition alone.

Use one state-specific anchor measurement to locate a new realization or nearby local formulation on the transferable thermal-response shape when it remains inside the supported local chemistry family.
Treat static viscosity, temperature response and thermal-hold stability as separate decision variables.
When the failure mode is hot-hold drift, choose an experiment and measurement window that directly test drift rather than only matching one nominal viscosity value.
Use external resin/tackifier evidence to define chemically plausible directions, but do not convert analogue proximity into a predicted local outcome.

one_point_state_calibration.interpretation: Within the tested local chemistry family, one state-specific viscosity anchor can locate a previously held-out nominal formulation on the shared thermal-response shape to roughly 6-10% pooled multiplicative error.
one_point_state_calibration.validation_scheme: leave one nominal formulation out; fit shared shape on the remaining formulations; use one anchor from the held formulation

state_shift_master_curve.interpretation: Within the chemistry-audited local family, a realization-specific viscosity-scale intercept plus a shared quadratic inverse-temperature response closes the data far better than a formulation-level intercept using the same thermal basis.

temporal_stability_coordinate.interpretation: Original E1 and E5 hold trajectories show that thermal-hold viscosity drift is strongly formulation dependent and should be treated separately from static viscosity.

thermal_coordinate.interpretation: The apparent temperature-sensitivity descriptor remains comparatively concentrated after chemistry auditing; it is a rheological descriptor, not a molecular reaction activation energy.

experiment_design_implications.hold_window: For the current local study, 120 C and the common 15-60 min window directly interrogate the observed instability while matching the available validation window.
experiment_design_implications.selection_target: Select a formulation-process point that is informative about the observed instability and state uncertainty, not merely the closest static-viscosity value.
experiment_design_implications.state_anchor: A single in-range anchor can be used for efficient local curve calibration; 120 C is operationally attractive because it is also the hold-stability test temperature.

provenance_audit.reason: The source record is phosphoric-acid-labelled and its additive identity/amount is not represented in formulations.csv; it is retained as sensitivity-only until chemistry is reconciled.

result.source_scope: original pre-validation local measurements with chemistry-comparability audit

tool_trace.name: get_candidate_hypothesis
tool_trace.reason: Needed to define the evidence-derived candidate regions and independent acrylic-like and tackifier-like axes before comparing candidate experiments.

evidence: PAT_US20160215185A1: repeated acrylic tackifying resin examples at approximately 19-20% of total formulation
PAT_US6465104B1 Example 10: 25 wt% low-OH acrylic copolymer with direct 121 C viscosity-stability data
PAPER_CN_ADHESIVES_2025_34_09_54: reports a 15% preferred acrylic-resin addition level, retained as directional lower-bound evidence until its fraction denominator is reverified
acrylic_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 20 and 25% are directly commensurate coarse anchors in the current curated record. The 15% grid level is retained as a lower-bound design point, but the literature denominator for the reported 15% addition level is not treated as an exact total-formulation anchor until reverified.

evidence: PAT_US5932680A: examples around 4.8-6.4% tackifying/hydrocarbon resin and preferred resin range 3-10 wt%
PAT_US20070155859A1: tackifiers/rheology-control agents typically used below about 10 wt%
minor_tackifier_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 5% represents the repeatedly documented minor-resin region and 10% is a conservative coarse upper level.

result.claim_boundary: External examples are analogues. They support candidate-family and coarse-region hypotheses, not an exact optimum for AC1920/TK100 and not a proven local molecular mechanism. The current reconstruction uses only pre-result evidence at runtime; the exact validation coordinates and outcome are excluded from candidate construction, ranking and tie-breaking.

decision_policy.claim_boundary: This policy can recover an evidence-supported formulation neighborhood, but it is not a predictor of the exact wet-lab optimum.

acrylic_like.basis: 15% directional lower-region evidence plus directly commensurate ~19-20% examples; 25% remains directly supported but is a larger perturbation.

minor_tackifier_like.basis: Curated PUR examples repeatedly place tackifying/hydrocarbon resin near 5%, with broader guidance below about 10%.

experiment_intents.causal_isolation: Use when the primary objective is attribution of one formulation axis. Prefer a single active modifier axis only in this mode.
experiment_intents.performance_mitigation: Use when a measured failure mode is already established and the next experiment is intended to reduce that failure. Independently supported multi-modifier interventions are admissible.
experiment_intents.uncertainty_resolution: Use when missing process, stoichiometric or evidence information prevents an interpretable performance test.

decision_policy.purpose: Select an experimentally informative intervention from pre-result evidence without treating a literature composition as the hidden optimum.
ranking_rules: Exact distance to an external analogue anchor is audit metadata, not a primary optimization objective.
Candidates in the same evidence-support class are not rewarded merely for being numerically closer to a literature percentage.
For performance mitigation, two modifier axes may be combined when each is independently supported and the combination stays inside bounded evidence regions.

Among candidates with comparable evidence coverage and interpretability, prefer the smallest sufficient total modifier burden and the smallest justified departure from the characterized local chemistry.
A single-variable design is preferred only when causal attribution is the stated experiment intent; it is not a universal default.
Held-out validation coordinates and outcomes must never enter candidate construction, ranking or tie-breaking.

historical_status.interpretation: The prospective historical claim attaches to the Agent recommendation itself. The current coarse grid and fine-refinement software are later reproducible operationalizations of the evidence-constrained region and are not represented as the original contemporaneous freeze algorithm unless older provenance is recovered.

local_reactive_core_anchor.reason: E2 is the geometric centre of the original five-point local design: 50/50 PPG2000/PDP-70 and NCO:OH=1.80, centered between E1/E3 stoichiometric perturbations and E4/E5 composition perturbations.
local_reactive_core_anchor.stoichiometry_note: The E2 NCO:OH=1.80 label applies to the original reactive core. If a modifier contributes reactive OH or another NCO-reactive group, true stoichiometry must be recalculated from verified material specifications.

stability_hypotheses.H1_formulation_family: Partial replacement of the reactive-only formulation by an acrylic-like and/or minor tackifier-like resin can reduce hot-hold viscosity drift under matched process conditions.
stability_hypotheses.H2_functionality: At comparable acrylic loading, lower effective reactive-group density or lower-OH acrylic chemistry is expected to be more favorable for hot-hold viscosity stability than more highly reactive acrylic chemistry.
stability_hypotheses.H3_region: A useful candidate region is expected within the externally supported coarse space spanned by 15-25% acrylic-like modifier and 0-10% minor tackifier-like modifier, while preserving the relative E2 reactive-core proportions.
